note: state: 'cast' = target.setCastingNow(true), 'bow_attack' = target is attacking now with a bow (attack end time in the future), 'idle' = neither (returns false without a draw). Needs AltGameCancelByHit (config) to include cast / bow. Every case has 'script' (the unit values u in [0,1) that were consumed) and 'rnd' (every Rnd call in order: method, bound, returned value; get_int bound b returns floor(u*b), get_int_range o,b returns o+floor(u*(b-o+1)), nextBoolean is u>=0.5). Calls that draw nothing (get with bound <= 0, get(origin, bound) with origin >= bound) are not recorded. Replay the returned values in order and check method and bound.

geometry.note: The target stands at 'target'. The attacker has heading 0 and z = target z + z_diff, and stands at attacker_xy_by_relation[relation] (found by trying 32 spots 40 units away until the real isInFrontOf / isOnSideOf / isBehind agree).
